prompts.title: Which decade is your personality from?
prompts.description: A playful quiz that reads you better than your friends do.
prompts.promptText: Ask me 10 quick questions, one at a time. Then tell me which decade my personality belongs in, and explain why with a bit of humor.

prompts.title: Turn yourself into a renaissance portrait
prompts.description: The classic. Works in any image generator.
prompts.promptText: A renaissance oil painting portrait of [describe yourself], dramatic candlelight, rich fabrics, ornate gold frame, museum quality.

prompts.title: Your day as a movie trailer
prompts.description: Make your Tuesday sound like a blockbuster.
prompts.promptText: Write a dramatic movie trailer voiceover script about my ordinary day. I will describe my day, you make it sound epic.

prompts.title: The dinner party test
prompts.description: Five guests, living or dead. What do your picks say about you?
prompts.promptText: Ask me to pick 5 dinner guests, living or dead. Then analyze what my choices say about my personality.

prompts.title: A tiny dragon on your desk
prompts.promptText: A tiny fluffy dragon the size of a hamster sleeping on a cluttered office desk, soft morning light, photorealistic macro shot.

prompts.title: Roast my fridge
prompts.description: Honest feedback on your life choices, plus dinner.
prompts.promptText: I will list what is in my fridge. Rate my life choices based on it, then suggest one dinner I can actually make tonight.

prompts.title: Your 90s yearbook photo
prompts.promptText: A 1990s high school yearbook portrait of [describe yourself], soft studio lighting, laser beam background, slight film grain.

prompts.title: The color test
prompts.description: Seven questions. One color. Surprisingly accurate.
prompts.promptText: Ask me 7 quick either-or questions, one at a time. Then tell me which color matches my personality and what it says about me.

prompts.title: What your playlist says about you
prompts.description: Your most played songs, analyzed by three very different experts.
prompts.promptText: I will paste my 10 most played songs. Tell me what a psychologist, a poet, and my grandmother would each conclude about me.

prompts.title: Your pet as royalty
prompts.description: Crown, cape, palace. Your pet deserves this.
prompts.promptText: A majestic royal oil painting portrait of my pet [describe your pet] wearing a golden crown and velvet cape, ornate palace interior, dramatic lighting.

prompts.title: Your city in a snow globe
prompts.description: Tiny landmarks, cozy lights, falling snow.
prompts.promptText: A miniature version of [your city] inside a glass snow globe, tiny glowing landmarks, cozy warm lights, falling snow, macro photograph.

prompts.title: Your houseplant saves the world
prompts.description: A two-minute bedtime story starring whatever is on your desk.
prompts.promptText: Write a short bedtime story where my [houseplant, coffee mug or pet] secretly saves the world every night. Make it warm and a little funny.

prompts.title: A country song about your day
prompts.promptText: Write a short country song about my day. I will describe what happened, you make it heartfelt and slightly dramatic.
